paper_title: Taming Graphs with No Large Creatures and Skinny Ladders
statement: Conjecture 4 of [4], a good restriction that excludes artificial examples as in the previous paragraph is to focus on induced-minor-closed graph classes.
context: However, it is still interesting to try to obtain a tighter classification between tame and feral graph classes for some more “well-behaved” hereditary graph classes. As discussed in Conjecture 4 of [4], a good restriction that excludes artificial examples as in the previous paragraph is to focus on induced-minor-closed graph classes.
